tokens.name: signature
tokens.usage: The identity hue, Periwinkle. Primary CTA fill, focus ring, selected state, brand mark. Surgical — never decoration. Deepens to #3F58C0 in light polarity; collapses to ink in survivalist.

tokens.name: signature-vivid
tokens.usage: Hover state of signature fills and the active toggle thumb. The D4 (saturation) step up from signature.

tokens.name: signature-muted
tokens.usage: Pressed state and depth under signature; light-polarity signature text. The D4 step down.

tokens.name: signature-dim
tokens.usage: Translucent signature for tracks and quiet fills (active toggle track, expanded accordion caret).

tokens.name: signature-glow
tokens.usage: Atmospheric signature wash, 10%: active tab background, hovered nav. Never neon.

tokens.name: signature-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Focus halo around inputs (20%).

tokens.name: signature-glow-intense
tokens.usage: Strongest atmospheric signature (35%) — card-glow border, rare emphasis.

tokens.name: signature-fill
tokens.usage: Background of signature-filled controls (primary button, accent badge, current page). Pair with on-signature.

tokens.name: signature-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background of signature-filled controls.

tokens.name: signature-text
tokens.usage: Signature as text — section labels, links. On surface-ground, surface-raised and bg-page. Light value fixed from the cyan-era leftover #1a6b7a. Terminal and overlay contrast fix 2026-10-05: ≥4.5:1 on page, raised and overlay in both polarities.

tokens.name: on-signature
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signature-fill. Stays light (#f5f3ed) in both polarities. Dark polarity: 3.8:1 on #5E79E6 — holds only for bold 19px+ labels; keep small text off the dark-polarity fill.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Coolant — informational, live, telemetry. Supporting hue; one job per context.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Cyan atmospheric wash (10%) — hover halos, frost-backdrop orbs.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Cyan wash at 20% — stronger halos.

tokens.name: accent-cyan-subtle
tokens.usage: Cyan tint at 8% — chip and tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-lime
tokens.usage: Energy, positive momentum. Use as a fill with dark ink (ground-0), never as text on light ground.

tokens.name: accent-lime-glow
tokens.usage: Lime atmospheric wash (10%) — hover halos, frost-backdrop orbs.

tokens.name: accent-lime-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Lime wash at 20% — stronger halos.

tokens.name: accent-lime-subtle
tokens.usage: Lime tint at 8% — chip and tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Warmth and emphasis. Fill or glow; as text only on dark ground at 19px+ bold.

tokens.name: accent-pink-glow
tokens.usage: Pink atmospheric wash (10%) — hover halos, frost-backdrop orbs.

tokens.name: accent-pink-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Pink wash at 20% — stronger halos.

tokens.name: accent-pink-subtle
tokens.usage: Pink tint at 8% — chip and tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Urgency, industrial, the NASA-hardware orange. Fills with dark ink; never for success.

tokens.name: ground-0
tokens.usage: D1 value step 0, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Absolute floor — recessed channels only (input, toggle and progress tracks). Never the page canvas. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-5
tokens.usage: D1 value step 5, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Canvas. The page ground (bg-page). Recessed surface in both polarities. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-10
tokens.usage: D1 value step 10, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Raised surface — cards, panels. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-15
tokens.usage: D1 value step 15, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Overlay surface — dropdowns, tooltips; subtle borders; skeleton base. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-20
tokens.usage: D1 value step 20, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Default border. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-30
tokens.usage: D1 value step 30, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Strong border; divider under emphasis. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-40
tokens.usage: D1 value step 40, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Disabled foreground; scrollbar thumb. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-50
tokens.usage: D1 value step 50, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Mid-tone. Placeholder-level marks, never body text. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-60
tokens.usage: D1 value step 60, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Subtle foreground — metadata, whisper text. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-70
tokens.usage: D1 value step 70, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Secondary foreground on dark. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-80
tokens.usage: D1 value step 80, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Default foreground — body copy. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-90
tokens.usage: D1 value step 90, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Near-top step; light-polarity canvas partner. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: ground-100
tokens.usage: D1 value step 100, warm-biased (amber by a degree). Boldest foreground — headings, Declaration. Off-white #f5f3ed in dark polarity, off-black #0d0d0c in light. Inverts 0↔100 in light polarity.

tokens.name: border-subtle

styles.name: declaration-hero
styles.usage: Hero word, uppercase, clamp(56px, 9vw, 112px). One per surface. Must pass the self-sufficiency test: 1–3 letters on an empty surface still carry identity.

styles.name: declaration-h1
styles.usage: Page title. Uppercase. Followed by emitter-declaration of clear space.

styles.name: declaration-alt-hero

styles.name: declaration-alt-h1
styles.usage: Mode B page title for sensorial, historically rooted projects.

styles.name: narrator-header
styles.sample: The Narrator raising its voice organizes; it does not command.
styles.usage: Header Narrator — section intros, lead paragraphs, structural landmarks. Sentence case.

styles.name: narrator-body
styles.sample: You should be able to read this for twenty minutes and never once think about the typeface.
styles.usage: Standard Narrator — all body copy. Must pass the twenty-minute test. Slightly heavier than convention, by intent.

styles.name: narrator-small
styles.usage: Interface labels, form help, list rows.

styles.name: narrator-whisper
styles.sample: Updated 14:32 — rewards the reader who looks closer
styles.usage: Whisper Narrator — captions, metadata, footnotes, in foreground-subtle. Never 9px light gray.

styles.name: technical-metric

styles.name: technical-default
styles.usage: Code, readouts, terminal output. Must pass the ambiguity test.

styles.name: technical-label
styles.usage: Section labels: uppercase, ultra-tracked, signature-text. Opens the rhythm label → Declaration → Narrator → content.
